breve: A singleton for managing TextServer implementations.
descricao:
TextServerManager is the API backend for loading, enumerating, and switching TextServers.
Note: Switching text server at runtime is possible, but will invalidate all fonts and text buffers. Make sure to unload all controls, fonts, and themes before doing so.

metodos.desc: Returns the interface registered at a given index.
Returns the number of interfaces currently registered.
Returns a list of available interfaces, with the index and name of each interface.
Returns the primary TextServer interface currently in use.
Removes an interface. All fonts and shaped text caches should be freed before removing an interface.
